fences.heading: Chain of one sale
fences.caption: Chain of one sale
fences.code:
flowchart TD
    classDef action fill:#f3e8ff,stroke:#a855f7,color:#1e293b,stroke-width:1.5px;

    Customer:::action --> QtReference:::action
    QtReference --> ProductionOrder:::action
    ProductionOrder --> OrderLine:::action
    OrderLine --> OrderProcess:::action
    OrderProcess --> ProgressEntry:::action
    OrderLine --> Product:::action
    Product --> ProductBom:::action
    ProductBom --> Material:::action
    Material --> MaterialLot:::action
    Material --> StockChange:::action
    ProductionOrder --> Invoice:::action
    Invoice --> InvoiceLine:::action
    Invoice --> Payment:::action
    Payment --> Receipt:::action

figures.caption: Chain of the new flows: Purchase
figures.code:
flowchart TD
    classDef action fill:#f3e8ff,stroke:#a855f7,color:#1e293b,stroke-width:1.5px;

    Supplier:::action --> SupplierMaterial:::action
    SupplierMaterial --> PurchaseOrder:::action
    PurchaseOrder --> PurchaseOrderLine:::action
    PurchaseOrder --> PurchasePayment:::action
    PurchaseOrder --> PurchaseAttachment[Attachment]:::action
    PurchaseOrder -- on Received --> StockChange:::action
    StockChange --> MaterialLot:::action

figures.caption: Chain of the new flows: Sale
figures.code:

QT form, customer PO]:::action ProductionOrder --> OrderLine:::action
